changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 13 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md`

- names `plugins/plugin-map.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` — edited by this change

  > The `@object-ui/plugin-map` README now describes one registered type, and its sentence claiming a bare array under `data` reaches the in-memory adapter is corrected: a bare array under `data` is not a record source on the map (objectui#8348), so inline rows belong under `staticData`. The same false claim is corrected on the two docs pages that carried it, `plugins/plugin-map.mdx` and `fields/location.mdx`.

### `.changeset/6121-retire-report-data-source.md`

- names `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` → `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` — edited by this change

  > **The TypeScript face** — both keys become `?: never` rather than being deleted, so an author who still writes one gets a `tsc` error at the authoring site instead of a silently stripped key. They were annotated `DataSource` / `DataSource[]`, the runtime ADAPTER interface (`find(resource, params)`), which no JSON document can author; that mis-annotation is the defect objectui#6121 was filed for, since every example on `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` authored a config object against it.

### `.changeset/6169-chatbot-authoring-face-type.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Out of scope, deliberately: the `chatbot-enhanced` and `chatbot-floating` registrations' own anonymous intersections (different key sets, a decision for a separate card in the same family), and the `surface` row on `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`'s Properties table, which names a key no registration in this package currently reads (filed separately).

### `.changeset/6475-gantt-block-face-declared.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Maintainer ruling, objectui#6475 (2026-08-27), **Option A** — enforce as-is, immediately, no warning window (the startup-stage no-gradualism rule, objectstack#12668: transitions do not get phased windows without named external-user evidence, and none exists here). A census of every `gantt` block reachable through `ObjectGanttSchema` in this repository — the `examples/schema-catalog` fixtures, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx`, and the published `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` guide — found **zero** blocks missing the trio.

### `.changeset/6687-chatbot-surface-authorable.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` — edited by this change

  > `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`'s `Properties` table listed `surface` (`'card' | 'plain'`, "bordered panel or a frameless full-page workspace"), but the key had **zero read points**: none of the three `ComponentRegistry.register('chatbot*', ...)` sites in `renderer.tsx` forwarded it, and `ChatbotSchema` did not declare it. `surface` was real only as a prop of the React component — `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` defines `ChatbotSurface`, defaults it to `'card'`, and branches six layout decisions off `isPlainSurface` — so it was reachable by a hand-written React host and by nobody writing metadata. An author who wrote `surface: 'plain'` got the `'card'` default, with no error and no signal.

### `.changeset/6896-retire-chart-inline-data.md`

- names `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` → `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` — edited by this change

  > ⚠️ One correction to the record the ruling rests on. The ruling states *zero* authorship of a populated `series[].data` outside tests across `packages/` / `apps/` / `examples/`. The re-measurement finds **one such site inside those roots** — `packages/types/examples/data-display-examples.json` (2 series) — plus **four outside** them, in documentation: `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` (3) and `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` (1).

### `.changeset/7295-chat-message-avatar-keys.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Same precedent as `CheckboxSchema.wrapperClass` (`b74a8598d`) and the objectui#6150 batch. `RuntimeOnlyMessageKeys` in `plugin-chatbot` is untouched; `SeamChatMessage` inherits the two keys through its `ChatMessage` half. The three example blocks on `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` that PR #7294 left unannotated (`supportChat`, `salesBot`, `multiAgentChat`) are annotated `ChatbotSchema` again.

### `.changeset/7313-object-calendar-record-source.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` — edited by this change

  > **A widening.** A node authoring `staticData` or `data` without `objectName` now validates (it always rendered — the read is `resolveRecordSourceConfig(schema)`, keyed on the three). Every document that validated before still validates: `objectName` alone still parses, an empty one included, because presence is `!== undefined`. The one shape the refinement refuses (none of the three) was refused before too, at `objectName`. The two static-data examples in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` are now annotated `ObjectCalendarSchema` and compile under the doc-snippet gate.

### `.changeset/7703-chatbot-dark-keys-retired.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` — edited by this change

  > `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` gains the restatement of the six removed keys with their replacements (`5f4514f7b`: a control is restated, never deleted into a vacuum), and its three present-tense claims that the `chatbot-floating` props spread is still unfiltered are corrected to what PR #8077 actually left behind.

### `.changeset/8221-retire-legacy-string-sort.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Director ruling, decision batch #77 (2026-09-07), option B. Three faces disagreed about one key: `@object-ui/core` implemented the string clause on purpose (`sort-query.ts`, docblock and all), `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` taught it as `sort?: string | SortConfig[]`, and the html tier answered `type-mismatch` for it because all seven `sort` registrations publish `type: 'array'` alone — while `@objectstack/spec` refuses the string outright on `element-record-picker`. Option A (per-block string arms) was rejected by name: it would make one key mean different things on different blocks.

### `.changeset/8516-8556-mirror-partial-record-narrowing.md`

- names `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` → `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx` — edited by this change

  > - grid nodes carrying an object-valued `columns` — **10 authored sites** (nine in `content/docs`, `examples/schema-catalog` and `skills/objectui`, one in `apps/site`), **all keyed inside the six breakpoints**. Every out-of-vocabulary key in either tree sits in a test fixture written to document the defect, or in objectui#8505's changeset quoting it. - `exportConfigs` — **one authored site**, `content/docs/core/report-schema.mdx`, keyed `pdf` / `excel` / `csv`, all **in vocabulary**. None in `objectstack`.

### `.changeset/8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` — edited by this change

  > - **At render.** `SchemaRenderer`'s lazy branch re-checks `hasLazy(type)` on every pass and returns the `Loading ANGLE-BRACKETS(type)…` placeholder. `Registry.register()` deletes a lazy entry only for keys the loaded module actually registers, so for an unfulfilled key the entry SURVIVES the load and every later pass takes the same branch. Measured on `b775500af` through the real chain: `{ "type": "line-chart" }` painted `role="status"` / `data-lazy-loading="line-chart"` / `Loading line-chart…`, permanently. **Not** the `OBJUI-001` panel the card expected — no alert, no error, no console warning. A skeleton that never resolves reads to a user as a slow network. - **At authoring.** A stub is enough to put a key into `getKnownTypes()`, so `check:doc-types` and the CLI's generated `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` snapshot both blessed all three. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` taught `"type": "line-chart"` inside a `card` body, and every gate was green on it.

### `.changeset/8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` — edited by this change

  > **The diagnostic's remedy text moves from a tag to a component.** It used to end "render `ANGLE-BRACKETS(kanban-ui)` from a React host that passes `onQuickAdd`". That sentence is falsified by this change: `kanban-ui` is no longer a node type key, so a page written to the old advice draws `unknown-component`. It now names `KanbanRenderer` from `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` — still exported, still forwarding both halves by identity — which is the surviving way to get the pair. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` says the same thing the same way.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `9419df198` (merge-base with origin/main): 9 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1804 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2414 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36718553706)

**One red, and what clears it.** `domain:devx` seat 2 (objectui#10917), `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, 2026-09-30T07:12Z.

- **CI on `73b9ae9`:** 35 success, 3 skipped, and 1 failure, **Doc Fence Language Check**. Doc Snippet Type Check and every other check are green.
- **Cause:** this PR's own re-fence. `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES` still lists the 8 batch pages (lines 438–445 on `main`), each now at 0 unhighlighted TS fences. The gate reports them STALE, and its remedy is to delete those 8 rows (a shrink-only ledger).
- **Blocker:** the maintainer authorised the deletion (objectui#5867 `5905984416`), but this session's classifier refused the edit twice (`[Modify Shared Resources]`). Per the authorisation's fallback, the maintainer makes the 8-row deletion by hand on this branch (details in objectui#5867 `5906087961`). This seat does not route it any other way.
- **Next:** on the head after that push, this seat confirms the fence check green and nothing else moved. Then it takes the contract-review record at tier (a `content/docs/**` review face), and ready plus the queue. The PR stays draft until then.

**`Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `52f1267`, and it is not this PR's.** Read at 2026-09-30T11:54Z by the `domain:devx` seat 2 stay-behind (`session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`).

- **Signature:** `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`, TS2741, "Property 'computed' is missing" in the `STRIPPED_LINE` table, and TS2344 in `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`, compiled against objectstack `main`. This PR touches neither file: its diff is 8 docs pages plus the fence ledger.
- **Cause:** objectstack `b2805465` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20805) adds `computed` to `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`. Since about 11:09Z the same diagnostics red every objectui run: PR #11205, and the merge groups of #11202, #11185 and #10278.
- **Fix:** objectui#11206, the p0 stop-the-bleed claimed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`5910146506`, branch `claude/issue-11206-computed-strip-reason`). It has no PR yet, so there is nothing to port. Porting it would also put this docs PR on that card's file surface.
- **Next:** when #11206 lands, this seat re-runs the gate on this head. A `pull_request` run compiles the merge with `main`, so the head does not move. Then the at-tier contract record goes on `52f1267`, then ready and enqueue.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d7a9fc17bae27a7e690434de98cfb4a6d21a3b95`
Local-runs: none

Read-only, as the brief prescribes: card objectui#5867 (body and all 26 comments), PR #11176 (body, its 3 comments including the changeset-claim-re-read bot comment 5905479659, the 9-file list and the net diff against the merge base `9419df198`), the head's blobs through `git show`, and the 40 check-runs on this head. Nothing built, run or re-run. Check-runs on `d7a9fc17`: 37 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix, `dependabot`), 0 failure, 0 in progress; `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Doc Fence Language Check`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Build Docs`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Test (shard 1-8)` and `Test (dist pins)` are all success.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **17 `plaintext` to `ts` re-fences on 8 whole pages** (report-schema 7; plugin-calendar 1; plugin-chatbot 2; plugin-dashboard 3; plugin-gantt, -kanban, -map, -timeline 1 each). Every re-fenced block opens with `import` or `interface`, i.e. it sits inside triage's classifier (card comment 5389690121); no prose block was re-fenced, and none of the 11 `content/docs` files the claim excluded (5905138724) is in the diff. **Right.** The dev's snippet-gate reading is blocks-to-compile 679 to 696, +17 = batch size, covered/ungated/fragments unchanged, 0 diagnostics; `Doc Snippet Type Check` is success on this head.

2. **plugin-gantt, TypeScript Support block:** `ObjectGridSchema` replaced by `ObjectGanttSchema` on both the import and the annotation of the `type: 'object-gantt'` node. `ObjectGanttSchema` is exported from `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and declares `gantt?: GanttConfig` (the pending `6475-gantt-block-face-declared` changeset). **Right** - the objectui#5044 class: the old block taught a TS2322 to any reader who copied it.

3. **report-schema, Report Sections block:** gains `import type { ChartSchema, ReportField, SchemaNode } from '@object-ui/types'`. All three are exported at the merge base (`data-display.ts`, `reports.ts`, `base.ts`). **Right.**

4. **report-schema, Scheduling block:** gains `import type { ReportExportFormat }` (exported from `reports.ts`) and renames the self-declared `interface ReportSchedule` to `ReportScheduleConfig`, the shipped name. I compared the self-declared body with `export interface ReportScheduleConfig` at the merge base: the same ten optional members, the `frequency` literal union equal to `ReportScheduleFrequency`, `formats?: ReportExportFormat[]`. **Right.**

5. **report-schema, Complete Example:** gains `import type { ReportComponentSchema }` (exported). The dev's ablation (`frequency: 'fortnightly'` reddens as TS2322 against `ReportScheduleFrequency`) shows the annotation is live rather than degraded to `any`. **Right.**

6. **The six self-declared interface blocks** (ReportField, ReportFilter, ReportGroupBy, ReportSection, ReportExportConfig, ReportScheduleConfig) are counted separately, not re-shaped, and claim no coverage - triage's execution note 2 on this card (#6143 closed `not_planned`). **Right.** I re-read each against `packages/types/src/reports.ts` at the merge base: ReportFilter, ReportGroupBy, ReportSection and ReportExportConfig are member-for-member identical (the doc spells `ReportExportFormat`'s union inline on `format`); ReportField's members match, with `aggregation` spelled as `ReportAggregationType`'s literal union. The dev's tsc parity probe agrees.

7. **`scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`:** exactly the 8 rows for the 8 batch pages are deleted from `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES` (7+1+2+3+1+1+1+1 = 17 = batch size), 0 lines added, no other line of the file moves; 72 rows remain, all `content/docs/components/**`. The map is shrink-only by its own docblock ("lower the number here - deleting the line when it reaches 0"), so this tightens the fence gate on those 8 files and moves no public surface. `Doc Fence Language Check` is success on this head. **Right.**

8. **Accept set: nothing moves.** No `packages/**` file, no zod schema, no export and no registration is in the diff. **Public surface: nothing moves.** `content/docs/**` and a repo-root script are in no released package's `files`. `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (shard 1-8)` and `Test (dist pins)` are success on this head.

9. **The 13 pending changeset bodies the re-read bot names** (5905479659) were each read against the diff. None of their claims goes false: the pages' prose and examples are byte-identical apart from the four fixes above, and the one claim that touches a changed block - `6475-gantt-block-face-declared`'s "a census of every `gantt` block reachable through `ObjectGanttSchema` ... found zero blocks missing the trio" - stays true, since the gantt TypeScript Support block, now reachable through `ObjectGanttSchema`, carries `startDateField`, `endDateField` and `titleField`. No body correction is owed.

10. **The merge commit `d7a9fc17`** brings `origin/main` at `9419df198` (objectui#11210, the `computed` strip-reason repair) into the branch; the net diff against the merge base is the 9 files above and nothing else. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

The diff publishes nothing from any released package: 8 `content/docs/**` pages plus one repo-root gate script. No `.changeset/*.md` is added and none is owed - `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are success on this head, and the dev's local reading of `check-changeset-presence` says the same ("no changeset is owed"), which is the authority objectui's own rule names for this question. No version bump, no `major`, no arm.

`Clause-②: no` in the PR body, with no `(widening)`/`(narrowing)` arm, is the declaration that matches the diff. **Matches.** (An empty-frontmatter changeset, as batch 5 wrote, would also be a legal declaration; it is not required when the gate itself reports nothing owed.)

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions` on the batch-6 report (5905522245): "Who deletes the fence gate's STALE map lines?"** - **Answered.** The maintainer authorised option A verbatim ("Authorize (Recommended)", recorded at 5905984416), the classifier refused the dev twice (5906020990, 5906087961), and the deletion landed on this branch as `52f1267`: exactly the 8 zero-count rows, nothing added, gate logic untouched, which is what the authorisation constrained. Noted, not blocking: the authorisation asked the commit to cite it and `52f1267`'s message does not; the PR body carries the citation instead. The standing rule for later batches (delete own zero-count rows only) is on the card.
- **Dev flag "Render: NOT MEASURED"** (site build not run locally). **Answered by the head's check-runs:** `Build Docs` is success on `d7a9fc17`, so the docs site built with these pages in CI. The shiki-span count earlier batches used as their render bar is not a gate and was not measured; 7 of the 8 pages already rendered `ts` fences through the same highlighter, and plugin-dashboard's first `ts` fence goes through the pipeline that renders the other 128 covered documents. Accepted as a reasoned expectation: the only reader-visible delta is highlighting, and the fence gate confirms the spellings.
- **Dev flag, Hazard 1 characterisation:** a misspelt top-level key on `ReportComponentSchema` compiles because `BaseSchema` carries an open index signature. **Answered, out of scope:** this is #6143's measured property, closed `not_planned`, with unknown-key rejection placed at the zod boundary by #5155's ruling; not this PR's to change.
- **Dev flag: the parity probe of the six self-declared interfaces holds only at this head; nothing re-runs it.** **Answered:** triage note 2 makes the separate count the remedy, and ① item 6 re-reads the members against the shipped types at the merge base. Later drift is the #6143 class, outside this card.
- **Dispatch-order boundaries** (5905138724): `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types*` is untouched; no `FRAGMENT_MARKER` and no exclude was added (all four reddened blocks are fixed); none of the excluded `content/docs` files is in the diff; the order's broader bar on editing `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` was lifted by the maintainer's authorisation above. **Answered.**
- **`Spec Main Shape Gate` red on `52f1267`** (PR comment 5910710592) was an unrelated objectstack change; the merge commit brought in objectui#11210 and the gate is success on this head. **Answered.**
- **Tests that read these pages:** the dev derived 32 root-vitest files (1077 tests passed at `73b9ae9`); `Test (shard 1-8)` and `Test (dist pins)` are success on this head. **Answered.**
- **Out-of-scope findings** (batch-7 remainder: 72 own-interface blocks in `content/docs/components/**`, 28 red on TS2304 only; the stale `UNGATED_DOCS` row in batch 5's handback): carriers named (batch 7 of this card); nothing owed on this PR.

No flag is left unanswered and none needs escalation.
